scenarios.title: Broke with 128k in the stash: withdraw, then buy portal scrolls and potions
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 8, purse 8, stash 128000 gold, belt emptied, by stat and belt verbs. Reachable by play (a stash that size is a late-game state at clvl 8 but not impossible), tagged SETUP-only.
scenarios.notes: Brief of the expansion card: hero 8 gold, stash 128k, needs portal scrolls and potions. hp1 is the minor healing potion and tbk the Tome of Town Portal (S: item codes). Gold is not asserted: what is left depends on the shopping.

assert.why: the bot took gold out of the stash
potions were bought into the belt
a Tome of Town Portal was bought (S: tbk); the kit needs portals

scenarios.title: Resupply: empty belt and no scrolls, gold in hand: fill the belt, buy portals
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 8, purse 1500, belt emptied. Reachable by play, SETUP-only.
scenarios.notes: The same kit shopping as town.stash-gold-withdraw with the money in the purse, so a red here is the shopping and a red only there is the withdraw.

scenarios.title: Belt policy: a belt with one healing potion left is topped up
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 10, purse 1500, belt emptied and one hp1 given. Reachable by play.
scenarios.notes: The state a fight leaves behind, set directly (a scenario does not need the fight). min 3 is the policy's floor (U: the class column target of the default build is not read from the policy table here; adjust when a green run shows the number).

assert.why: U: the bot tops the column up from one

scenarios.title: Hurt hero in town takes the free heal before leaving
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 10, purse 500, four hp1 in the belt, life brought to 40 percent with debug hit. Reachable by play.
scenarios.notes: A short budget so the hero is not hurt again by the field after the heal. The saved life is the observed fact (the saved hero stores current life, U: the lab d2d restores it on load).

assert.why: the hero was healed in town (Akara, free heal) before the walk out

scenarios.title: Below the chicken line with an empty belt: leave, rest and restock, come back healed
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 10, purse 5000 (the bot buys the portal tome and scrolls first, 650 of 800 in pgfix4 run 20261120-131852; the purse must cover the kit AND what it buys), belt emptied, life brought to 15 percent with debug hit (the game's own hurt path), field start in the Blood Moor by debug goto 2 (CHEATED position).
scenarios.notes: 15 percent is under chickenPct's default (knob range 15 to 45). The run is judged by the end state of the live d2d: life restored, kit bought (no potion-less re-entry), and at most 8 area changes (leave, town, return, not a loop).

assert.why: rested or healed before going on
leave, heal, return: not a loop

scenarios.title: Loot: an unidentified rare ring on the ground is taken up and decided
scenarios.provenance: CHEATED item: an unidentified rare ring dropped beside the hero by debug give rin 6 unid (a rare ring is a normal drop, but not at this moment). A stocked belt (2 hp1, 2 mp1; the starter belt has four slots) so the Sorceress does not leave for a kit trip before the loot step sees the ring (pgfix4 run 20261120-132609: she left at once for mana potions and never came back to it). Farm goal in the Blood Moor: the loot sweep runs after fights in the area, a level goal walks on to Cold Plains and Stony Field before any sweep (pgfix4 run 20261120-132834). Field start in the Blood Moor by debug goto 2. Mechanics only.
scenarios.notes: The observer reads the floor only of the level the hero ends in (the town, where the vendor shelves count as floor: a ring there proves nothing), so the ring is judged by what it earned: picked up, identified and sold, the purse and stash hold more than 700 (pgfix4 run 20261120-133236: 2115 after the sale; without the pick-up the hero stays under 400). Red = the ring was left lying.

assert.why: the ring was picked up, identified and sold (a rare ring sells for well over the purse 300 plus a kit; the bank chore moves gold to the stash, so purse and stash are summed)

scenarios.title: Anti-flail: no more than 12 area changes in 40 virtual minutes on the tree step
scenarios.provenance: As cain.scroll: waypoints set by debug wp and the level by stat verbs (CHEATED waypoints). Mechanics only.

assert.why: the sandbox cycled Dark Wood, Cold Plains and the camp for 17 hours

scenarios.notes: The counter is the number of `zone entry` lines of the bot's own log after the first (one line per area change, internal/bot/lifelog.go; S: the bot's report of what the game told it, written by the observer into state.area_changes and area_trail). The first live run of the tree step cycled Dark Wood, Cold Plains and the camp (docs/process/proving-ground.md section 9): this scenario is the number that stops it. Red means the flail hold did not stop the cycling; fixing it is not part of the Proving Ground card.
